QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] The Grand Finale
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart started a small investigation before the party. Does this guy ever relax? Better ask him about it.
QuestInfo.1: Help out your fellow Maplers in Maple Castle and reveal the castle's secrets in Neinheart's stead.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Phantom, Lania, and Angelic Buster prepare for the party, AND you learned about Maple Castle's history. What a productive day!

0.0: I actually found several clues to the #bhistory of Maple Castle#k while preparing for the party.\r\nI asked #rPhantom, Lania, and Angelic Buster#k for some help in sorting through everything, but they haven't gotten back to me yet.
0.1: The empress is eager to get the party preparations done, so if I were to leave now she's sure to be...displeased. \r\nThat's why I need you, #b#h0##k, to go to those #r3 people#k and retrieve the #bMaple Castle clues#k for me.

yes.0: I knew I could count on you. #rPhantom, Lania, and Angelic Buster#k are around #bMaple Castle#k preparing for the party. Just pick up the clues from them. I will continue my investigation. And decorating for the party, I guess.
yes.1: What's with that skeptical look? You must forget what I said earlier. Please.

no.0: If you don't want to help, then don't offer!

1.0: Did you collect the #bMaple Castle clues#k from Phantom, Lania, and Angelic Buster?

yes.0: Ah, so that's how #bMaple Castle#k faded away into history... I doubt we'll find any remaining magic if the students already destroyed it all.\r\nStill, I have nothing but respect for the Maple Castle students who made such sacrifices to prevent the Black Mage from becoming stronger.
yes.1: Thanks for all your help, #b#h0##k. I don't think we should pry into Maple Castle history any further. Seems it was another victim of the Black Mage's nefarious schemes. What a shame.
yes.3: I can't help but note your skeptical gaze. Forget what I said earlier about the empress's test sheet. I suggest you be about your business.

default.0: Search #bMaple Castle#k for #rPhantom, Lania, and Angelic Buster#k and get the clues from them.
